License: OFL-1.1; full original license in fonts/OFL.txt.
Retrieved 2026-10-23. The source font has no Reserved Font Name declaration.
Transformations: fontTools 4.61.1 instantiateVariableFont with wght=400,
wdth=100; Subsetter with U+0020–U+007E plus ĄČĘĖĮŠŲŪŽąčęėįšųūž for
NotoSans-Regular.woff2, ASCII only for NotoSans-ASCII.woff2; WOFF2 output.
The ASCII variant is exclusively a negative-test fixture and is never published
as an accepted local font. Both subsets may be redistributed under the OFL.
The preview fixture materializes the already-inventoried cinematic-photo CC0
forest and its RIGHTS.txt at test time, without duplicating that photograph.
The cuboid, SVG fallback, HTML and JavaScript are original atlas MIT code.
